entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: A species of large gelatinous medusaform beings from a gas giant, living in the Edge and members of Pinnacle.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Organization with vast libraries of pan-species knowledge that the Illvoi joined.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: Private research group headquartered on Uthros, with Administration, R&D and Security branches.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: World with the Combine's secret installation deep in its core.

entities.name: Solidbodies Research
entities.description: Smaller research group that competes with the Combine.

entities.name: Sothera system
entities.description: Star system where Illvoi are associated with the Uthros Combine.

entities.name: World-eater
entities.description: A titanic entity with reality-bending and time-warping ability, the main subject of Uthros Combine research.

events.summary: The Illvoi build vessels and travel to the stars, where they meet Pinnacle and join it.

relations.note: A member of its scientific consensus arm.
relations.quote: a promising member among Pinnacle's scientific consensus arm
It is the primary competitor of Solidbodies Research
The main subject of Uthros Combine research is a titanic entity
